content: react-cytoscapejs (plotly) latest is 2.0.0 published 2022-09-02; repo last pushed 2025-01-27 with 45 open issues including a known Next.js CJS/ESM 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' failure. peerDeps are react >=15.0.0 and cytoscape ^3.2.19 so npm will not block React 19, but the package is effectively unmaintained and predates React 18 StrictMode double-effect and React 19. Recommendation: use cytoscape 3.34.0 directly in a client component with useRef + useEffect and a cy.destroy() cleanup, loaded via next/dynamic ssr:false.
